errors.text: The fracture-morphology prediction is reversed: the target associates HPHT treatment with distributed/isolated microcracks and the brittle baseline with elongated interfacial cracks, whereas the generated hypothesis predicts elongated cracks after treatment and treats isolated microcracks as evidence of brittle failure.
The predicted outcome omits the target's defining quantitative result of approximately 1150 MPa fracture strength and 36% uniform tensile elongation.
